This binding may trigger Slco4a1 to participate in the transport of organic anions, which is then facilitated by Slco4c1. The integration of these pathways implies that Liothyronine could influence the activity of Slco4c1 through its interaction with Slco4a1, potentially altering the transport of organic anions. This mechanism highlights a possible role for Liothyronine in modulating the function of Slco4c1, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction and functional significance.
